facts.text: I did an analysis of a covid call centre for medical professionals.
The first dataset outlines the number of calls containing the keyword "Error".
The "Error" keyword referred to Vaccine Errors.
The second dataset outlines the number of webinars that took place for medical professionals.
The second dataset also includes the number of newsletters sent out related to Covid 19 Vaccine Errors to inform medical professionals.
The third dataset is the number of Covid vaccines given in relation to date.
I asked for trends and for how the three data sets might relate to each other.

events.text: Analysis requested for trends across three covid datasets (calls with "Error"/Vaccine Errors, webinars/newsletters, and weekly covid vaccinations).
